# Fiddler AI

> Enterprise AI Control Plane for observability, security, and governance of agents and LLMs with guardrails and compliance.

Fiddler AI provides a unified platform for monitoring, protecting, and governing AI systems across the enterprise. The platform combines agentic observability, LLM guardrails, and AI governance to enable safe, compliant AI deployments across government, healthcare, insurance, and financial services.

## Key Topics

- AI Observability
- AI Agents
- LLM Monitoring
- Guardrails
- AI Governance
- Agentic Observability
- Model Monitoring
- AI Security
- Hallucination Detection
- Risk Management
- MLOps
- Enterprise AI
- PII/PHI Protection
- Compliance
- Trust Service

## Core Platform

- [Fiddler AI: AI Control Plane for Enterprise Agents](https://www.fiddler.ai): Fiddler AI Control Plane for enterprise agent observability, security, and governance.
- [The Control Plane for AI Agents](https://www.fiddler.ai/control-plane): Enterprise Control Plane for AI agents with telemetry, evaluation, and governance.
- [AI Observability and Security Platform](https://www.fiddler.ai/ai-observability): Unified AI observability platform with guardrails and governance for enterprise.
- [Agentic Observability](https://www.fiddler.ai/agentic-observability): Agentic Observability across agent lifecycle with evaluation, monitoring, analytics.

## Security & Governance

- [Fiddler Trust Service: AI Guardrails & LLM Monitoring](https://www.fiddler.ai/trust-service): Fiddler Trust Service for LLM scoring, guardrails, and safe deployments.
- [Fiddler Guardrails for Enterprise LLM Protection](https://www.fiddler.ai/guardrails): Low-latency LLM protection with hallucination and jailbreak prevention.
- [AI Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance (GRC)](https://www.fiddler.ai/ai-governance-risk-compliance): Centralized AI governance with observability, guardrails, audit trails.
- [Responsible AI](https://www.fiddler.ai/responsible-ai): Responsible AI systems with bias detection, governance, and explainability.

## Industry Solutions

- [Government](https://www.fiddler.ai/solutions/government): Fiddler for government agencies with model monitoring and explainable AI.
- [Healthcare](https://www.fiddler.ai/solutions/healthcare): Healthcare AI with monitoring and guardrails for PHI/PII protection.
- [Insurance](https://www.fiddler.ai/solutions/insurance): Insurance AI observability with NAIC-aligned governance and guardrails.
- [Lending and Trading](https://www.fiddler.ai/solutions/lending-and-trading): AI observability for lending and trading with compliance and risk management.
- [Customer Experience](https://www.fiddler.ai/solutions/customer-experience): Monitor and protect customer-facing AI agents with compliance and security.
- [Customer Lifetime Value](https://www.fiddler.ai/solutions/lifetime-value): AI observability for personalization, pricing, and customer retention.

## ML Operations

- [The Leader in AI Observability for MLOps](https://www.fiddler.ai/mlops): AI Observability platform for MLOps lifecycle monitoring and model analysis.

## Integrations & Partnerships

- [Fiddler AI and Amazon SageMaker AI: Unified MLOps at Scale](https://www.fiddler.ai/partners/amazon-sagemaker-ai): Fiddler integration with Amazon SageMaker for MLOps and model monitoring.
- [NVIDIA and Fiddler: Accurate and Safe LLM Applications](https://www.fiddler.ai/partners/nvidia): NVIDIA NIM and Fiddler integration for secure LLM deployment and monitoring.
- [Accelerating AI Solutions with Fiddler and Databricks](https://www.fiddler.ai/blog/accelerating-the-production-of-ai-solutions-with-fiddler-and-databricks-integration): Fiddler and Databricks integration for accelerating AI production workflows.
- [Fiddler Integration for Datadog APM](https://www.fiddler.ai/blog/fiddler-mpm-integration-for-datadog-apm): Datadog and Fiddler integration for monitoring ML metrics in APM dashboard.
